title: parcel.created
description: Published by S2 Parcel & Pricing once per new booking (not for idempotent replays). Kafka topic parcel.created, key = parcel id (aggregateId). Delivery is at-least-once; consumers de-duplicate on eventId. Contains no names, phone numbers, addresses or customer ids; merchantId (merchant parcels only) is the merchant account id.

source.description: How the parcel was created: CUSTOMER_BOOKING for customer bookings, MERCHANT_ORDER for merchant orders.

merchantId.description: Merchant account id (the merchant's Keycloak subject). Present only for merchant parcels; absent for customer bookings. Optional, added for merchant webhooks (#32).
